overview: The Board approved a site plan modification for the Saltonstall Building redevelopment to optimize parking layout and pedestrian safety. Staff also provided an extensive update on the citywide zoning overhaul timeline and development initiatives for municipal lots in Medford Square.

items.title: 121 Riverside Avenue Site Plan Modification
items.summary: Approved a modified site plan for the Saltonstall Building allowing the Medford Housing Authority to reconfigure 111 residential and 27 administrative parking spaces following land acquisition from MassDOT. The update eliminates parallel parking and improves on-site circulation and pedestrian paving.

items.title: Zoning Overhaul and City Planning Updates
items.summary: Staff briefed the Board on the collaborative zoning recodification process with the City Council, including upcoming workshops focused on the Mystic Avenue and Salem Street corridors. The update included a report on the status of the Great American Beer Hall and a planned RFP for a 99-year lease to develop residential units on city-owned parcels behind City Hall.
